mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_document_chunks WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY chunk_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.* FROM rag_chunk_embeddings e JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id=e.chunk_id WHERE c.document_id=#{documentId} AND c.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY e.chunk_id,e.embedding_model,e.vector_store LIMIT 100001 FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.* FROM rag_chunk_search_index_state s JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id=s.chunk_id WHERE c.document_id=#{documentId} AND c.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY s.chunk_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: generation_id AS id,document_id AS documentId,source_hash AS sourceHash,product_sha AS productSha, baseline_hash AS baselineHash,manifest,preview_hash AS previewHash,state
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM rag_chunk_search_terms s JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id=s.chunk_id WHERE c.document_id=#{documentId} AND c.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY s.chunk_id,s.term LIMIT 100001 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM rag_recovery_generations WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND preview_hash=#{previewHash}

SELECT document_id AS documentId,revision,active_generation AS activeGeneration,source_hash AS sourceHash,baseline_hash AS baselineHash FROM rag_recovery_pointers WHERE document_id=#{documentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM rag_recovery_generations WHERE generation_id=#{generationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId,c.document_id AS documentId,c.chunk_version AS chunkVersion,c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.parent_section_title AS parentSectionTitle,c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle,c.section_type AS sectionType, c.chunk_text AS chunkText,c.embedding_text AS embeddingText,c.page_no AS pageNo,c.source_path AS sourcePath, c.source_url AS sourceUrl,c.sort_order AS sortOrder,c.content_hash AS contentHash,c.quality_status AS qualityStatus, c.quality_reason AS qualityReason,c.source_provenance AS sourceProvenance FROM rag_recovery_members m JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id=m.chunk_id JOIN rag_recovery_generations g ON g.generation_id=m.generation_id AND g.document_id=c.document_id WHERE m.generation_id=#{generationId} AND c.use_yn='N' ORDER BY c.sort_order,c.chunk_id LIMIT 10001 FOR UPDATE

SELECT generation_id AS generationId,chunk_id AS chunkId,manifest,embedding_model AS embeddingModel, vector_json AS vectorJson,receipt_hash AS receiptHash FROM rag_recovery_embedding_receipts WHERE generation_id=#{generationId} ORDER BY chunk_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT generation_id AS generationId,manifest,vector_collection AS vectorCollection,vector_fingerprint AS vectorFingerprint, lexical_fingerprint AS lexicalFingerprint,chunk_count AS chunkCount FROM rag_recovery_assets WHERE generation_id=#{generationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_recovery_pointers WHERE revision!=0
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_recovery_embedding_receipts SET write_status='UNCERTAIN' WHERE generation_id=#{generationId} AND chunk_id IN #{id}
UPDATE rag_recovery_embedding_receipts SET write_status='VERIFIED' WHERE generation_id=#{generationId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_recovery_embedding_receipts WHERE generation_id=#{generationId} AND write_status='VERIFIED'
SELECT revision,lexical_generation AS lexicalGeneration,lexical_fingerprint AS lexicalFingerprint FROM rag_recovery_routing_epoch WHERE singleton_id=1
SELECT document_id AS documentId,revision,active_generation AS activeGeneration,source_hash AS sourceHash,baseline_hash AS baselineHash FROM rag_recovery_pointers ORDER BY document_id LIMIT 10001
SELECT b.generation_id FROM rag_recovery_baselines b JOIN rag_recovery_pointers p ON p.document_id=b.document_id AND p.active_generation=b.generation_id ORDER BY b.document_id LIMIT 10001
